# CoreWeave Raises Prices Approximately 25% Across Product Specs in July

2026-08-11 21:34:14

CoreWeave's Chief Financial Officer announced in July that the company raised prices by approximately 25% across its product specifications to address current market demand and pass through rising component costs. The CFO noted that improvements in operating margins occurred prior to the July price adjustment.
